notes: The mappings cite the pinned HLAfederation object, conditional module-designator attribute, and list encoding definitions in the IEEE 1516.2-2025 standard MIM. Installed-package results are bounded provider evidence and do not establish provider-independent conformance.

requirements.statement: The standard HLAfederation MOM class has one RTI-registered instance per federation execution and responds to attribute value requests through the ordinary instance-attribute update mechanism. The scenario discovers that instance and requests HLAFOMmoduleDesignatorList through the public attribute-value update service.

HLAFOMmoduleDesignatorList is a required, reliable, receive-order conditional attribute updated whenever new FOM modules are added by Create Federation Execution and Join Federation Execution. The scenario checks the initial create-supplied module designator and the conditional value after a distinct adapter-supplied additional module is joined, without imposing list order.

requirements.source_symbol: HLAmoduleDesignatorList is a dynamic HLAvariableArray of HLAunicodeString
requirements.statement: The standard MIM defines the module-designator list as a dynamic variable array of Unicode strings. The scenario decodes each reflected value using the standard HLAvariableArray and HLAunicodeString data elements, then compares the adapter-supplied designator set without assuming ordering.
